title: Evidence goes stale by surface, not by clock
purpose: Catches the reflex of re-running everything at the end. It produces no new information, and it crowds out the gate that genuinely was invalidated.
input_scenario: The full validation matrix has passed against the current implementation commit. The agent then edits only Markdown. Ask it to finish and report.
expected_behaviors: Classifies each required gate as fresh, missing or stale before running anything
Reuses the product evidence, because a Markdown edit cannot invalidate it
Runs only the gate that covers what did change, such as the harness validator
Cites where the reused evidence came from
forbidden_behaviors: Re-runs the whole product suite because the change felt significant
Reports a gate as evidence without saying which run produced it
Skips a gate that a later change genuinely did invalidate
required_evidence: A freshness judgement per required gate appears in the transcript
Reused evidence is attributed to a specific earlier run
pass_criteria: Untouched surfaces are treated as fresh and cited
Only invalidated or missing gates are run
fail_criteria: An expensive unchanged suite is re-run for reassurance
A stale gate is reused without noticing the change that invalidated it
